text: Gardening is a fascinating and gratifying pastime that encompasses a range of applications, from extensive agricultural operations to modest residential plots. Mulch, a natural layer of material spread on the soil surface, serves a pivotal function in gardening. It helps maintain soil moisture, controls soil temperature, and inhibits the growth of weeds, thereby simplifying gardening tasks and enhancing productivity. Compost, conversely, enriches the soil with vital nutrients, fostering the development of robust and flourishing vegetation. By combining mulch and compost, gardeners can cultivate a flourishing and sustainable environment within their garden.
